app-week-report|app|MOBILE|T|Weekly report sheet (opened from the 'This week' card on the #/stats progress page). A proud, cozy recap: a small header 'Your week' with a back arrow, a teacher slot with a short cheering bubble, a big friendly XP number with an up-arrow chip showing the change versus last week, a chunky 7-day bar chart of daily XP (Mon–Sun, today highlighted, one quiet empty day), then a row of 4 small stat tiles with glossy icons (new words, reviews, quizzes, active days) each with a tiny +/− change chip, then two side-by-side cards 'Strongest' (a skill with a shiny star) and 'Needs practice' (a skill with a gentle arrow and a small 'Practice' tactile button). A big orange 'Keep going' tactile button at the bottom.

app-badges|app|MOBILE|-|All badges collection (opened from the badge row on the #/stats page). Header 'Badges' with a back arrow and a small '7 / 19' counter chip. A grid of 19 round glossy illustrated medallions, 3 per row, each with a short name under it: earned ones are bright, colorful and slightly raised with a soft shine; locked ones are flat, desaturated with a small padlock and a thin progress ring. Badge themes: hatching chick (first review), green notebook, stack of books, grand library (word collections 50/200/500), brain (10 mastered), trophy (100 mastered), small flame, volcano, diamond (streak 3/7/30), rocket (500 reviews), perfect-score medal, microphone (pronunciation), open book (reader), lightning bolt (speed), owl (night learner), early bird, archer's bow (word hunter), military medal (level 5), golden crown (level 10). No text inside the medallions.

app-badge-detail|app|MOBILE|-|Badge detail bottom sheet (tap one badge on the badges page): a big glossy diamond medallion floating with a soft glow and sparkle, the badge name 'Diamond', one short line 'Keep a 30-day streak', a date chip 'Earned 12 Oct',. Only this earned state. Tactile buttons 'Share' (secondary) and 'Close' (orange). The page behind is dimmed.

app-badge-unlocked|app|MOBILE|T|Badge unlocked celebration pop-up (shows right after finishing a lesson when a new badge is earned): soft confetti sparkle, a big glossy rocket medallion bursting out of a ring of light, title 'New badge!', the badge name 'Review machine', one short line, a teacher slot at the side with a tiny happy bubble, and tactile buttons 'Share' (secondary) and 'Continue' (orange). Joyful but light.

app-badge-sheet|app|DESKTOP|-|An icon sheet (design asset board, not an app screen): on a clean background, a neat grid of glossy illustrated achievement icons in one consistent candy-tactile style, each in a rounded tile with a tiny caption under it. Row 1–3: the 19 badges — hatching chick, green notebook, stack of books, grand library, brain, trophy, small flame, volcano, diamond, rocket, perfect-score medal, microphone, open book, lightning bolt, owl, early bird, archer's bow, military medal, golden crown. Row 4: 8 streak milestone flame medallions that grow richer with the number — 3, 7, 14, 30, 50, 100, 180, 365 (the number in a small ribbon under each flame, not inside the art). Row 5: lesson crown levels — a crown in 5 tiers (bronze, silver, gold, emerald, legendary purple). No other text inside any icon.

share-streak|share|DESKTOP|T|A square 1080x1080 social share image for a streak achievement (it is an image, not a web page): a bold warm composition with the kite logo and 'Lexkite' small at the top, a huge glossy flame medallion with '45' big beside it and 'day streak' under it, a teacher slot on one side, a tiny 7-day row of lit circles, and a small footer strip with a QR code square placeholder and 'lexkite.com'. Fills the whole square edge to edge, no page chrome.

share-band|share|DESKTOP|T|A square 1080x1080 social share image for an IELTS band estimate (an image, not a web page): the kite logo small at the top, a big glossy ring with 'IELTS 6.5' in the center and 'estimated band' under it, four small rounded skill chips under the ring (Listening 7.0, Reading 6.5, Writing 6.0, Speaking 6.5), a teacher slot on one side with a proud pose, and a footer strip with a QR code placeholder and 'lexkite.com'. Edge to edge, no page chrome.

share-cert|share|DESKTOP|-|A landscape 1600x1130 course completion certificate image (an image, not a web page), playful but worthy: a soft decorative border with tiny kite and star motifs, the kite logo at the top, 'Certificate of completion', a big learner name 'Minh Anh', 'has completed', the course name 'IELTS Foundation — 30 lessons', a glossy gold medallion seal with a ribbon, a date and a short verify code at the bottom, and a QR code placeholder in a corner. Clean, balanced, printable.

og-blog|og|DESKTOP|-|A 1200x630 link preview image (Open Graph card) for a Lexkite blog post (an image, not a web page): warm cream background, the kite logo and 'Lexkite blog' small at the top-left, a big bold two-line article title 'How to get Band 7 in IELTS Writing Task 2', a small category chip 'IELTS Writing' and a reading-time chip '8 min', and on the right a glossy illustrated scene of an open notebook with a pencil and a little kite. Generous margins, title readable at thumbnail size.

og-word|og|DESKTOP|-|A 1200x630 link preview image (Open Graph card) for a Lexkite dictionary word page (an image, not a web page): the kite logo and 'Lexkite dictionary' small at the top-left, the headword 'serendipity' huge and bold, a part-of-speech chip 'noun' and the IPA '/ˌser.ənˈdɪp.ə.ti/' with a small speaker icon, one short meaning line, level chip 'C1', and on the right a soft glossy illustrated abstract shape (sparkles and a kite tail) with no words in it. Title readable at thumbnail size.

email-welcome|email|DESKTOP|T|A welcome email for a new learner — ONLY the email itself, no website header or footer (HTML email, 600px wide, centered on a cream background). Kite logo header, a big friendly 'Welcome to Lexkite!' title, a teacher slot with a short hello bubble, three small illustrated step tiles (pick your exam, 5 minutes a day, keep your streak), one big tactile orange 'Start my first lesson' button, and a small footer with 'Manage emails · Unsubscribe' links and the address line.

email-streak|email|DESKTOP|T|A gentle streak reminder email — ONLY the email itself (HTML email, 600px wide, centered). Kite logo header, a glossy flame illustration with '12' and 'day streak', a short title 'Keep your streak alive', a teacher slot with a kind short bubble, a 7-day row with today's circle empty and pulsing, one big tactile orange 'Do a 3-minute lesson' button, a smaller line about streak freeze, and a small footer with 'Remind me less · Unsubscribe' links. Kind, never guilt-tripping.
